facts.fact: ZBC News reports the government is developing the Zimbabwe Social Registry (ZISO), a database to identify households eligible for social assistance, to be rolled out across the 65 districts, per Minister Edgar Moyo.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare

facts.fact: The Herald reports the 2025/2026 Zimbabwe Social Registry Survey was launched in Nkayi district by ZimStat with the Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare, collecting household data for a national social registry and spreading progressively across 65 districts.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare

facts.fact: The World Bank PID says the first phase of social registry data collection was completed in December 2025 in Mangwe district, extending to Nkayi and Mudzi to cover two percent of the population, with ZISO still needing large-scale enumeration to be fully operational.

systems.system: ZISO (formerly Integrated Social Protection Management Information System, ISPMIS)
systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service, Labor, and Social Welfare

facts.fact: ZIMSTAT's press release says it, with the Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare, launched the 2025 Zimbabwe Social Registry Survey to collect household data to establish a Zimbabwe Social Registry.

systems.owner: ZIMSTAT with Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare

facts.fact: The Herald reports the Zimbabwe Social Registry (ZISO) software is 85 percent complete per a Public Service ministry official, with a questionnaire to be piloted in four or five districts before data is uploaded.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare

note: The document concerns the handover of voter registration to the Registrar-General and says nothing on a social registry.
